hack.root_cause: Math bug — constant product formula check broken by inconsistent parameter change (1000→10000)
hack.description: Uranium Finance's Uniswap V2 fork changed a constant from 1000 to 10000 in two places but not the third, breaking the x*y=k check and letting an attacker drain $57.2M by swapping 1 wei for 98% of each pool.
